summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) extending a lender forbearance under its Credit Agreement from June 12 to June 19, 2026. No specific deal terms, stake, price, or premium are disclosed. The filing reports ongoing constructive discussions with the agent and lenders toward an amendment but no definitive agreement. This is a routine liquidity update, not a special situation such as restructuring or going-private. The filing lacks any transaction or event that would qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
